info.title: Geoapify Route Planner API
info.description: Assign jobs and pickup-delivery shipments to agents and optimize their routes and schedules.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

post.summary: Optimize jobs and shipments across agents
post.description:
Optimizes jobs and pickup-delivery shipments across one or more agents.

- Send `mode`, `agents`, and at least one non-empty `jobs` or `shipments` array in a JSON body.
- Coordinates use GeoJSON order: `[longitude, latitude]`; reusable entries in `locations` can be referenced by index.
- Agent capabilities must satisfy task requirements; capacities, priorities, durations, time windows, and breaks constrain assignment and order.
- A regular API call supports up to 300 unique coordinates across locations, agents, jobs, and shipments.
- Each returned GeoJSON feature is one agent plan with actions, waypoints, route legs, timing, distance, and `MultiLineString` geometry.
- Unassigned agents, jobs, or shipments are reported in `properties.issues` when the complete task cannot be assigned.

**Example:** optimize 73 pickup-delivery shipments across three passenger-car agents with `mode=drive`.

requestBody.description: Route optimization task. The request body must be JSON. The compact example uses one agent, one job, and one shipment to demonstrate the request structure.

200.description: Optimized plan. Each GeoJSON feature represents one assigned agent route; collection properties contain normalized task parameters and any assignment issues. The example route coordinates are intentionally simplified to demonstrate the GeoJSON MultiLineString and planner result structure. Actual routes contain more detailed geometry.

400.description: Invalid optimization task or a task that exceeds Route Planner gateway limits.

value.message: "value" must contain at least one of [jobs, shipments]

Too many location coordinates. Total amount of coordinates for locations, agents, jobs, and shipments should not exceed 300 for a regular API call, and 1000 for an asynchronous batch API call. Request contains 301 coordinates.

routeTooLong.summary: A location pair exceeds the travel-mode limit
routeTooLong.description: This example uses `walk`, which allows 100 km for regular calls and 200 km for asynchronous batch calls.

value.message: Too long distance between locations. Distance should not exceed 100000 meters for a regular API call, and 200000 meters for an asynchronous batch API call. Estimated distance is 250000 meter(s).

sumDistanceTooLong.summary: Estimated total distance is too large

value.message: Too long sum distance. Sum distance of all possible routes should not exceed 300000000 meters for a regular API call, and 1000000000 meters for an asynchronous batch API call. Estimated sum distance is 350000000 meter(s).

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

mode.description: Travel profile used for all agent routes. `drive` represents passenger cars.

agents.description: Resources—such as vehicles or workers—to which jobs and shipments can be assigned.

jobs.description: Independent service or delivery tasks. At least one job or shipment is required.

shipments.description: Paired pickup-delivery tasks. Pickup always precedes delivery and both are assigned to the same agent.

locations.description: Reusable coordinates referenced by zero-based `location_index` fields. Regular calls may contain at most 300 unique coordinates across the complete task.

avoid.description: Road features, locations, polygons, or countries the calculated agent routes should avoid.

traffic.description: Traffic model for motorized modes. `free_flow` assumes uncongested roads; `approximated` accounts for likely congestion.

type.description: Route preference used for agent travel. `balanced` balances time and distance; `short` prioritizes distance; `less_maneuvers` penalizes turns.

max_speed.description: Maximum speed for driving, truck, and bus modes. Use 10–252 km/h with `units=metric`, or 6.5–155 mph with `units=imperial`.

units.description: Unit system for returned route distances. `metric` returns meters; `imperial` returns miles.

id.description: Optional unique location identifier returned with related plan actions and waypoints.

location.description: Reusable coordinate in GeoJSON order: `[longitude, latitude]`.

end_location.description: Optional agent end coordinate. Alternative to `end_location_index`.

start_location_index.description: Zero-based index in `locations` for the agent start.

end_location_index.description: Zero-based index in `locations` for the agent end.

pickup_capacity.description: Maximum amount the agent can pick up.

delivery_capacity.description: Maximum amount initially loaded for delivery.

capabilities.description: Capabilities available to satisfy job or shipment `requirements`.

time_windows.description: Agent availability windows in relative seconds.

breaks.description: Optional breaks scheduled within one of their allowed time windows.

time_windows.description: Intervals in which the break may start.

pickup_amount.description: Amount added to the agent pickup load.

delivery_amount.description: Amount removed from the agent delivery load.

requirements.description: Capabilities an agent must have to perform the job.

time_windows.description: Intervals in which an agent must reach the job.

location.description: Pickup or delivery coordinate. Alternative to `location_index`.

duration.description: Pickup or delivery service duration in seconds.

time_windows.description: Intervals in which an agent must reach this stop.

requirements.description: Capabilities an agent must have to handle the shipment.

amount.description: Shipment amount counted against agent capacity.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by the API gateway.

ApiKeyInQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyInQuery.description: Geoapify API key query parameter. Recommended authentication method for public APIs. API keys in URLs can be logged; use x-api-key for server-to-server clients.

ApiKeyInHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyInHeader.description: Geoapify API key header. Supported as an alternative authentication method for public APIs.
